title: Lead Engineer - Drive System Specialist
intro: A leading systems integrator in Telford is looking for a Lead Engineer with deep drive systems expertise. Reporting to the Director of Engineering and Innovation, you will be accountable for the engineering delivery of projects, lead and mentor teams of engineers, and own the functional safety lifecycle.
bullets: Own the functional safety lifecycle and the Technical Construction File on projects
Supervise and motivate project engineering teams, including external resources
Mentor apprentices, trainees, junior and graduate engineers
Lead electrical, controls and software design for PLC, HMI, SCADA, robot and drive systems
Lead Factory Acceptance Testing, commissioning and Site Acceptance Testing
outro: This form takes around 15 minutes. Specific examples help us put the strongest candidates forward.
